item.subject: science
item.stem:
Meena's mother is cooking dal for dinner. Before cooking, she washes the dal and pours away the cloudy water containing dust and small stones. Later, she churns curd to collect the butter from it.

Which statement correctly describes the purpose of each separation?

options.A: Washing the dal collects the useful dust, and churning removes the unwanted butter.
options.B: Washing the dal removes an unwanted component, and churning collects a useful component.
options.C: Washing the dal collects a useful component, and churning removes an unwanted component.
options.D: Both washing the dal and churning the curd are done to remove unwanted components.
